decision: the census found no defect and no pathology on the production path, so the source is frozen exactly as proposed: 35% neutral_v1 + 65% accepted P10-D learned selector with the accepted reflection/perturbation behaviour. No repair was needed; no new setup-source implementation identity was created.

definition.entry_point: stratego.training.phase10_selector.LearnedSetupSource(candidate('P10-D'), load_scorer(), load_library_index()).draw(SelectorRequest(split='train', color, selector_seed)) — the branch coin applies the 35/65 mixture internally
definition.post_selection_behaviour: accepted neutral_v1 profile on both branches: reflection probability 0.5 (left-right file mirror), perturbation probability 0.5, uniform swap-count 1..6, Flag cell pinned by the frozen perturbation contract
definition.orientation_requirement: every engine placement MUST go through the accepted orientation helper — SelectorDraw.oriented(player) / SampledSetup.oriented(player) / orient_setup(canonical, player) — before create_game. Passing the canonical tuple directly to create_game for BLUE places the army back-to-front; this exact mistake exists in stratego/belief/phase11b/corpus.py (Phase11BSetupSources.draw returns canonical tuples consumed unoriented by Phase 11B/12 game construction) and produced the Phase 12 '47/64 front-row flag' observation. Phase 14 collection integration (Agent 2) must bind the oriented path and MUST NOT reuse the Phase 11B glue.
definition.per_side_independence: the two sides of one game are drawn independently with their own selector seeds, as in the accepted Phase 10 soak

census_binding.census_headline: P_trivial 0.003296 (threshold 0.05), P_predecision 0.001953 (threshold 0.025), 0 defects over 32,768 draws / 8,192 paired engine boards / 1,024 adapter equality checks; all front-row Flags trace to family F15 (irregular_high_entropy) whose contract allows flag_rank 0..3; the learned branch selects F15 slightly LESS than neutral (mass 0.045-0.052 vs 0.0625); reflection and perturbation changed the Flag row 0 times in 32,768 draws

valid_but_strategically_poor_report: About 1.2-1.4% of production draws carry a front-row Flag (about 0.7-0.8% in an open file), entirely from the by-design irregular_high_entropy family; about 0.33% of paired boards start with an immediate scout lane to a Flag. This is legal, matches the accepted Phase 9 exposure regime (~0.24% observed 1-2-ply endings), and is reported without repair per the predeclared policy. Phase 10 is not reopened.
phase10_evidence: unchanged and preserved; this document adds a Phase 14 binding, it does not modify phase10_system_v1
